baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a Mighty air purifier. A home air purifier with a pre-filter, deodorisation filter and HEPA filter, a motor and fan, control and power boards, an ionizer and a moulded plastic housing. The Mighty air purifier is assembled in Vietnam using components sourced from Vietnam and China.

The motor, HEPA filter and main module and power module printed board assemblies are produced in Vietnam. The ionizer, particle sensor, power cord assembly and harness are sourced from China. 

Final assembly in Vietnam: pre-assemble the control, power and sensor sub-assemblies; install frame, fan and motor, filters, boards and housing; test and pack.

key_factors: Motor, HEPA filter, and main/power printed board assemblies, along with final assembly
prediction.decisive_step: Production of the motor, HEPA filter, and PCBAs, and final assembly of the unit in Vietnam
prediction.reasoning: In Vietnam, the critical components that impart the essential character of the air purifier—specifically the motor, HEPA filter, and main/power printed circuit board assemblies—are manufactured, and all components are assembled into the finished appliance. Consistent with CBP precedent on air purifiers (e.g., H323218, N359250), the Chinese components (ionizer, sensor, cord, harness) undergo a substantial transformation when integrated with the Vietnamese-origin core functional components during final assembly in Vietnam.

rejected.description: Make Motor-fan assembly and PCBA (SMT) in China
rejected.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a Mighty air purifier. A home air purifier with a pre-filter, deodorisation filter and HEPA filter, a motor and fan, control and power boards, an ionizer and a moulded plastic housing. The Mighty air purifier is assembled in Vietnam using components sourced from China.

The motor, HEPA filter, main module and power module printed board assemblies and ionizer, particle sensor, power cord assembly and harness are produced in China. 

In China, the motor and HEPA filter will be produced in-house: stamp rotor laminations from silicon steel; stack laminations and wind the rotor; build the stator; assemble the motor; press-fit the fan to the motor spindle (assumed from the product-family template; no operations were supplied for this group).

In China, the main module and power module printed board assemblies will be produced in-house: SMT placement and reflow of the printed circuit board assembly; test the PCBA (assumed from the product-family template; no operations were supplied for this group).

Final assembly in Vietnam: pre-assemble the control, power and sensor sub-assemblies; install frame, fan and motor, filters, boards and housing; test and pack.

key_factors: Motor, fan, HEPA filter, and PCBAs
prediction.decisive_step: Manufacturing of the motor, HEPA filter, and PCBAs in China
prediction.reasoning: All critical functional components of the air purifier—the motor, fan, HEPA filter, ionizer, particle sensor, and main/power PCBAs—are completely manufactured in China through complex processes like lamination stamping, rotor winding, and SMT reflow. Unlike H323218, N359250, or N357771 where substantial component manufacturing or complex multi-country integration occurred in the assembly country, the operations in Vietnam consist merely of simple sub-assembly and final assembly of pre-made Chinese components, which does not constitute a substantial transformation.

verdict.reasoning: In H323218 (affirming NY N322364 and NY N322681) and the paired rulings N359250/N359251, CBP examined air purifiers assembled in Vietnam or Thailand where sourcing of the motor, HEPA/composite filter, and printed circuit board assemblies shifted to China. In both instances, CBP held that multi-step sub-assembly and final integration of the air purifier's mechanical, electrical, and filtration systems in the assembly country resulted in a substantial transformation, so moving the motor, HEPA filter, and PCBAs to China did not alter the country of origin.
